title: Show the authored reason and explicitly chosen replacement
preconditions: Use a content target with a deprecation reason and an independently addressable replacement.

steps.action: Open deprecation inspection for a reason containing literal <script>unsafe</script>.
steps.expected_result: The reason is rendered as escaped text without executing authored markup.

steps.action: Author a deprecation naming the replacement explicitly and inspect it.
steps.expected_result: The authored reason and exactly selected replacement are visible.

expected_result: The authored reason and exactly selected replacement are visible.
